groepsmailboxVerplichting.description:
Determines whether a medewerker must be linked to a contactverzoek when the selected afdeling or groep has no groepsmailbox.
Env: `USE_GROEPSMAILBOX_VERPLICHTING`
More informationWhen `true`, the medewerker field becomes required (with a visible reason) if no email address is known for the selected afdeling or groep. A contactverzoek can then not be created without a medewerker. When `false`, the medewerker field stays optional, regardless of the groepsmailbox.

customHeaders.description:
Custom headers to send to the Haal Centraal API, for instance when using a proxy. A value can be a string (sent with every search) or an object with a value per search type. See [Using KISS with a proxy for BRP / KvK](#using-kiss-with-a-proxy-for-brp--kvk-for-example-iconnect).

userHeaderName.description:
Header name to include the user id to send to the Haal Centraal API, for instance when using a proxy. The value of the claim configured in `settings.oidc.medewerkerIdentificatie.claim` is sent. See [Using KISS with a proxy for BRP / KvK](#using-kiss-with-a-proxy-for-brp--kvk-for-example-iconnect).
Env: `HAAL_CENTRAAL_USER_HEADER_NAME`
userHeaderName.title: userHeaderName

customHeaders.description:

Env: `KVK_CUSTOM_HEADERS__`
customHeaders.title: customHeaders

userHeaderName.description:

Env: `KVK_USER_HEADER_NAME`

apiKey.description:
Secret that KISS uses to validate the JWT Token when requesting contactmoment details. See the [managementinformatie chapter of the KISS manual](https://kiss-klantinteractie-servicesysteem.readthedocs.io/nl/stable/manual/managementinformatie.html) on how to use this API.
Env: `MANAGEMENTINFORMATIE_API_KEY`
apiKey.title: apiKey

authority.description:
URL of the OpenID Connect Identity Provider.
Env: `OIDC_AUTHORITY`
authority.title: authority

beheerderRole.description:
Name of the role for a Beheerder. Must match the name of the role in the Identity Provider. Default: `Beheerder`. A user with this role can edit Skills, Kanalen, Gespreksresultaten and Contactverzoek formulieren. See the [KISS manual](https://kiss-klantinteractie-servicesysteem.readthedocs.io/nl/stable/manual/manual.html).
When [PABC](#pabc-platform-autorisatie-beheer-component) is configured, the role comes from PABC, but KISS only accepts a PABC role with this name. Leave this empty (or use the default) when using PABC.
Env: `OIDC_BEHEERDER_ROLE`
beheerderRole.title: beheerderRole

clientId.description:
Client ID for access to the OpenID Connect Identity Provider.
Env: `OIDC_CLIENT_ID`
clientId.title: clientId

clientSecret.description:
Secret for the OpenID Connect Identity Provider.
Env: `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET`
clientSecret.title: clientSecret

kennisbankRole.description:
Name of the role for a Kennisbank employee. Must match the name of the role in the Identity Provider. Default: `Kennisbank`. A user with this role can only search the configured sources (Kennisbank, VAC, Smoelenboek, websites).
When [PABC](#pabc-platform-autorisatie-beheer-component) is configured, the role comes from PABC, but KISS only accepts a PABC role with this name. Leave this empty (or use the default) when using PABC.
Env: `OIDC_KENNISBANK_ROLE`
kennisbankRole.title: kennisbankRole

klantcontactmedewerkerRole.description:
Name of the role for a Klantcontactmedewerker (KCM). Must match the name of the role in the Identity Provider. Default: `Klantcontactmedewerker`. A user with this role can register contactmomenten and contactverzoeken, and search the sources.
When [PABC](#pabc-platform-autorisatie-beheer-component) is configured, the role comes from PABC, but KISS only accepts a PABC role with this name. Leave this empty (or use the default) when using PABC.
Env: `OIDC_KLANTCONTACTMEDEWERKER_ROLE`
klantcontactmedewerkerRole.title: klantcontactmedewerkerRole

claim.description:
The claim used to identify the medewerker in the registers. Default: `email`.
Env: `OIDC_MEDEWERKER_IDENTIFICATIE_CLAIM`
More informationWhen writing data to e.g. Open Klant or Open Zaak, a `medewerkerIdentificatie.identificatie` is required. Municipalities use different values for this. When integrating with e.g. the e-Suite, this must contain the e-Suite username of the logged in KCM.
claim.title: claim

truncate.description:
Optional maximum number of characters of the claim, after which it is truncated. Example: `24`. Default: no truncation.
Env: `OIDC_MEDEWERKER_IDENTIFICATIE_TRUNCATE`
More informationWithin ZGW, a `medewerkerIdentificatie.identificatie` may not be longer than 24 characters. Use this setting to truncate the value after 24 characters.
truncate.title: truncate

redacteurRole.description:
Name of the role for a Redacteur. Must match the name of the role in the Identity Provider. Default: `Redacteur`. A user with this role can edit Nieuws- en Werkberichten, Links and VACs (if configured). See the [KISS manual](https://kiss-klantinteractie-servicesysteem.readthedocs.io/nl/stable/manual/manual.html).
When [PABC](#pabc-platform-autorisatie-beheer-component) is configured, the role comes from PABC, but KISS only accepts a PABC role with this name. Leave this empty (or use the default) when using PABC.
Env: `OIDC_REDACTEUR_ROLE`
redacteurRole.title: redacteurRole

organisatieIds.description:
RSIN of the organisation that registers the contactmomenten. Several ZGW APIs, including the Klanten and Contactmomenten APIs, require the RSIN of the own organisation when registering specific objects.
Env: `ORGANISATIE_IDS` (separated by `/`)
organisatieIds.title: organisatieIds

apiKey.description:
API key for authentication with PABC (sent as `X-API-KEY` header).
Env: `PABC_API_KEY`
apiKey.title: apiKey

baseUrl.description:
Base URL of the PABC API, without trailing slash. Example: `https://pabc.mijngemeente.nl`.
Setting both `baseUrl` and `apiKey` activates the PABC integration. See [PABC](#pabc-platform-autorisatie-beheer-component).
Env: `PABC_BASE_URL`
baseUrl.title: baseUrl

Env: `REGISTERS____…`
